record.title: Microduck head chassis plate — 73.5 x 54.2 x 18.8 mm frame holding the head-roll and mouth XL330 servos, the camera lens tube and the head electronics shelf
record.why: cad/part.py builds one valid solid and ce-cad/bin/cad-refcheck grades it against Pollen's own published mesh reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/motor_support.stl: p95 surface distance 0.363 / 0.456 mm (ref->ours / ours->ref), median 0.013 / 0.017 mm, bbox delta 0.00 mm per axis, 6/6 reference holes and bosses matched, 0 unmatched (r6, 2026-09-02; evidence/refcheck/2026-09-01T19-55-33Z).
record.origin_why: modelled by hand in cecad from measurements taken off Pollen Robotics' decimated visual mesh (CC BY-SA-NC sim asset) with cecad.meshslice plane cuts (the traced outline literals in part.py), interval calipers and cecad.meshfeatures; nobody has Pollen's CAD and no physical part has been measured. Replaces the v0.0.1 mesh loader.
record.why_this_folder_exists: The head has one internal chassis: everything in the head (roll servo, mouth servo, lens tube, electronics shelf) bolts to this plate. Nothing on the shelf is that part.
